title: Triangulatedness after derived-quotient precomposition
statement: For l, E, L, ι, X and any CommShift c on integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X, the composite DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X is IsTriangulated with the induced shift.

source.place: Paragraphs 1-5: finite-free Roos cones, signed shifts, and localization transport before descent.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs 1-5: finite-free Roos cones, signed shifts, and localization transport before descent.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib provides Functor.isTriangulated_of_precomp; no theorem proves the scalar composite itself.

from.place: Paragraphs 1-5: finite-free Roos cones and localization transport.

proof.text: Prove the strict Roos cone and localization composite preserves distinguished triangles, with the selected coherent shift.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_precomp_triangulated
    (c : (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).CommShift ℤ) :
    let _ := c
    (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι X).IsTriangulated
